tasks.title: Implement Product Management Functions
tasks.description: Develop functionality allowing store owners and sales personnel to create and update product records.

tasks.title: Implement Customer Account Management
tasks.description: Develop functionality allowing store owners and sales personnel to create and update customer account records.

tasks.title: Implement Catalog Browsing
tasks.description: Develop catalog browsing interface accessible to users without mandatory sign-in.

tasks.title: Implement Shopping Cart Logic
tasks.description: Develop shopping cart capabilities including addition of products, quantity adjustment to positive integers, and item removal.

tasks.title: Implement Order Submission Flow
tasks.description: Implement order placement requiring successful sign-in before placement, rejecting empty-cart submission, creating one order with the selected products and quantities, and displaying its reference on successful submission. No numeric reference format is specified.

acceptance_criteria.given: Run separately for each actor role in {Store owner, Sales personnel}
acceptance_criteria.when: the actor creates a new product using permitted product data
acceptance_criteria.then: the new product record is created for each tested actor role

source.quote: Store owners and sales personnel can create and update products and customer accounts.

acceptance_criteria.given: Run separately for each actor role in {Store owner, Sales personnel}
acceptance_criteria.when: the actor creates a new customer account using permitted account data
acceptance_criteria.then: the new customer-account record is created for each tested actor role

source.quote: Store owners and sales personnel can create and update products and customer accounts.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer and available products in the store
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer browses the product catalog
acceptance_criteria.then: the store displays the available products

source.quote: Store owners and sales personnel should be able to manage products and customer accounts, while customers should be able to browse the available products, maintain a shopping cart, and place orders through the store.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer and a product that is available for addition to the cart
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer performs the add-to-cart action for that available product
acceptance_criteria.then: the selected available product is present in that customer's cart

source.quote: Customers can add available products to the cart, change quantities to positive whole numbers, and remove items.

acceptance_criteria.given: A signed-in customer has a nonempty cart containing available selected products with positive whole-number quantities
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer successfully submits the cart as an order
acceptance_criteria.then: exactly one order is created containing the same selected products and quantities; the successful-submission result displays that order's reference

source.quote: Customers may browse without signing in but must sign in before placing an order. Customers can add available products to the cart, change quantities to positive whole numbers, and remove items. Store owners and sales personnel can create and update products and customer accounts. Orders are submitted for staff processing; online payments and shipping integrations are outside the first release. A successful submission creates one order containing the selected items and quantities and displays its reference.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer is not signed in
acceptance_criteria.then: the customer can browse without being required to sign in

source.quote: Customers may browse without signing in but must sign in before placing an order.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer is not signed in and has a nonempty cart
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer attempts to place an order before signing in
acceptance_criteria.then: no order is placed before successful sign-in; the attempt cannot complete order placement while the customer remains signed out

source.quote: Customers may browse without signing in but must sign in before placing an order.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer has an available product in the cart; run separately for each quantity in {1, 3, 5}
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer sets the cart item's quantity to the selected positive whole-number example
acceptance_criteria.then: that cart item has exactly the selected positive whole-number quantity

source.quote: Customers can add available products to the cart, change quantities to positive whole numbers, and remove items.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer has an item in the cart
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer removes that item from the cart
acceptance_criteria.then: that item is no longer present in the customer's cart

source.quote: Customers can add available products to the cart, change quantities to positive whole numbers, and remove items.

acceptance_criteria.given: An existing product; run separately for each actor role in {Store owner, Sales personnel}
acceptance_criteria.when: the actor updates that product's permitted product data
acceptance_criteria.then: the existing product record reflects the requested changes for each tested actor role

source.quote: Store owners and sales personnel can create and update products and customer accounts.

acceptance_criteria.given: An existing customer account; run separately for each actor role in {Store owner, Sales personnel}
acceptance_criteria.when: the actor updates that account's permitted customer-account data
acceptance_criteria.then: the existing customer-account record reflects the requested changes for each tested actor role

source.quote: Store owners and sales personnel can create and update products and customer accounts.

acceptance_criteria.given: A signed-in customer has a nonempty cart with selected available products and positive whole-number quantities
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer successfully submits the order
acceptance_criteria.then: the successful-submission result displays the reference of the order just created

source.quote: Customers may browse without signing in but must sign in before placing an order. Customers can add available products to the cart, change quantities to positive whole numbers, and remove items. Store owners and sales personnel can create and update products and customer accounts. Orders are submitted for staff processing; online payments and shipping integrations are outside the first release. A successful submission creates one order containing the selected items and quantities and displays its reference.

acceptance_criteria.given: A signed-in customer has an empty cart
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer attempts to submit that empty cart
acceptance_criteria.then: submission is rejected and no order is created from the empty cart

source.quote: Customers may browse without signing in but must sign in before placing an order. Customers can add available products to the cart, change quantities to positive whole numbers, and remove items. Store owners and sales personnel can create and update products and customer accounts. Orders are submitted for staff processing; online payments and shipping integrations are outside the first release. A successful submission creates one order containing the selected items and quantities and displays its reference. An empty cart cannot be submitted.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer has a cart item with a positive whole-number quantity; run separately for each input in {0, -1, 1.5}
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer attempts to set that item's quantity to the selected invalid-domain example
acceptance_criteria.then: the supplied zero, negative or fractional number is not accepted as the resulting cart quantity; cart quantities remain positive whole numbers

source.quote: Customers can add available products to the cart, change quantities to positive whole numbers, and remove items.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer has a nonempty cart of available products with positive whole-number quantities; the order attempt is gated because the customer is signed out
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer successfully signs in and explicitly submits the order
acceptance_criteria.then: the sign-in precondition is satisfied and the successful explicit submission creates one order with the selected items and quantities

Customers can add available products to the cart, change quantities to positive whole numbers, and remove items. Store owners and sales personnel can create and update products and customer accounts.
